# netbox_modules (Data Source)

Retrieves all modules from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_modules" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "status"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "modules_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_modules.example.modules[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `modules` (Attributes List) The modules found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modules`

Read-Only:

- `asset_tag` (String) The asset tag of the modules.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the modules.
- `created` (String) When the modules was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the modules, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the modules.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the modules.
- `id` (Number) The id of the modules.
- `is_bay_compatible` (Boolean) The is bay compatible of the modules.
- `last_updated` (String) When the modules was last changed.
- `module_bay_id` (Number) The ID of the module bay associated with the modules.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the modules.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the modules.
- `serial` (String) The serial of the modules.
- `status` (String) The status of the modules.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
